title: Activation Analysis of Arsenic-Doped Silicon Substrates Using Atom Probe Tomography (APT) and Differential Hall Effect Metrology (DHEM)
content: Arsenic (As) implantation into monocrystalline silicon (M-Si) and polycrystalline silicon (poly-Si) substrates, followed by rapid thermal annealing (RTA) at 950°C, was characterized using transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and atom probe tomography (APT). Carrier concentration depth profiles with nanoscale resolution were obtained using differential Hall effect metrology (DHEM).
